factual_claims.claim: Dream-RSI achieves competitive or improved discovery quality while substantially reducing discovery cost across algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering.

Dream-RSI reduces the average wall-clock runtime of Lasso regularization path solvers across six held-out downstream datasets from 3587.1ms to 2931.0ms using Gemini-3.1 Pro while utilizing 317 discovery-agent calls compared to 550 calls for Recursive Fixed Exploration, and from 2516.7ms to 2350.6ms using Gemini-3.7-Flash with 1879 calls instead of 3200.
